name: Supermax Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约公告，公告主要为季度业绩、年报、股东大会及股份回购授权等常规事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract for its business segments; announcements were mainly routine matters such as quarterly results, annual report, general meetings, and share buyback authority.
